hook_line: NAVDEEP BAINS WINS ONTARIO LIBERAL LEADERSHIP ON FINAL BALLOT

hook_stat.sub: Navdeep Bains's share on the final ballot, against Lee Fairclough's 49.7%

stats.label: Party members voted in the leadership contest
Seats the Ontario Liberals hold in the legislature

diaspora_bullets: First visible minority to lead the Ontario Liberal Party
A five-time MP for Mississauga and Brampton ridings
news_summary: Navdeep Bains was elected leader of the Ontario Liberal Party on November 21, 2026, beating Lee Fairclough 50.3 per cent to 49.7 per cent on the third and final ballot.
payoff: Bains now has to rebuild a party that holds 14 seats in the legislature.
